memberdef.name: UpwindControlVisitor

detaileddescription.para: set maximum size of time step
access to upwind matrix of specified phase (density) and element
define upwind nodes for CVFEM scheme - and calculate velocitites if requested

sect1.title: Motivation
sect1.para: Specialized visitor to define upwind nodes for CVFEM scheme.

sect1.title: Usage
sect1.para: To be used within the CVFEM scheme (Weis et al., Geofluids, 2014).

sect1.title: Dependencies
sect1.para: The functions are tailored for use in ExplicitFiniteVolumeTransportPHX. This visitor is needed in TwoPhaseTransportPHX and Upwind-PDE-operators.

sect1.title: Testing
sect1.para: testing was done in the period before publication in 2014.
